It sits beside lib/take-about (what a take was said for), which joins the same stores, and reads them the same way: Studio's stores are handed in by a route. A row in My data and a card in Takes carry an "In use · <what>" badge. My data's one delete sheet (LA19) gains a stronger first panel naming each use and what it loses, a "Delete it anyway" button, and "No spoken card, Studio video, idea or week you sent picks it" when nothing does.
